subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Orientation - My family
source.subtopic: What a family is; members of my family (immediate and extended); different types of families (inclusivity)

show.line: Families are different. Some are big, some small. Gogos, aunts and cousins are family too!

rounds.prompt: Who lives in your home? Name one person.

rounds.story: Dineo lives with her gogo and her cousin. Is that a family?
rounds.praise: Yes! Families come in all shapes.

hints: Extended family is aunts, uncles, cousins and grandparents.
Any group that loves and cares is a family.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A family must have ten people.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: A small family is not a family!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Small families are families too.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Big or small, it is a family!

parent_line: Can name family members, including extended family, and knows families differ.
